name: rtl-docx
description: RTL-first Word workflow for coding agents: Markdown builds, native redlines, tracked edits, comments, OOXML validation and render verification.

interface.shortDescription: Persian/RTL Word docs: build, redline, verify
interface.longDescription: Create Persian/Arabic right-to-left Word documents from Markdown, redline two DOCX versions, propose tracked changes with per-region receipts, add comments, validate OOXML, and render pages for visual review.
defaultPrompt: Build a Persian Word report from this Markdown and verify it.
Redline these two DOCX versions with tracked changes.
Audit this DOCX for untracked edits and Persian typos.
